purpose: Require every DLC release to resolve into traceable content records across all applicable domains.

verification_policy.official_baseline: establishes existence and DLC provenance only
verification_policy.indexed: identity captured but gameplay fields unresolved
verification_policy.partially_verified: some gameplay fields have direct provenance
verification_policy.verified: required fields resolved with adequate provenance

final_dlc_rule: Future Saga Chapter 4 is the final DLC; subsequent records must not invent a later paid DLC chapter.
